description: This file implements the ChannelMonitor class and related classes for handling modem simulator command channels, including client management, command parsing, and I/O multiplexing.

classes.name: ClientId
classes.description: Represents a unique identifier for a client connection.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Represents a client connection, including its file descriptors and response handling.

classes.name: ChannelMonitor
classes.description: Manages multiple client connections, handles command I/O, and runs the main monitoring loop for the modem simulator.

methods.description: Constructor initializing a new ClientId with a unique ID.

methods.description: Sends multiple responses to the client.

methods.name: ChannelMonitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the monitor with a modem and server socket.

methods.description: Adds a remote client connection and triggers the monitor loop.

methods.description: Reads and processes a command from a client.

methods.description: Sends an unsolicited response to the first connected client.
